thread:
Alex M: quick heads-up, partner lab ran our end-to-end perf/W sweep and saw recurring P99 spikes after ~25-35m when sustained power >700W.
Samir: which image + kernel did they use?
Alex M: Raven-2026.03 + our kernel patch set v3.2.1 (the recent sched/irq affinity + powercap changes).
Jessie: can you paste the short log around one of the spikes? even a 1-min window helps.
Alex M: snip from hwmon:
```
[2026-03-20T21:12:10Z] t=69C power=710W throughput=472tps p99=210ms
[2026-03-20T21:12:42Z] t=74C power=735W throughput=476tps p99=520ms
[2026-03-20T21:13:05Z] thermal_throttle gpu0 drop 1530->900MHz
```
Priya: partner said BMC fan curves are intentionally conservative on those racks. could be late ramping.
Samir: that dmesg line reads like a thermal governor event. might be OEM sensor offsets too. ask for BMC logs and IPMI temps.
Alex M: asked partner for BMC dump and pwrcap status. bench-bot queued run #458 to repro.
bench-bot: queued run 458: model=redwood-rlhf-small seq=2048 target=480tps dur=45m telemetry=on
Jessie: plan on our side: 1) repro on identical node here 2) run with powercap enabled/disabled 3) toggle our kernel patch vs baseline. keep samples 1s hwmon + dmesg capture.
Alex M: local slot booked 09:00 PST tomorrow. test command I'm using:
```
./bench.sh --model redwood-rlhf-small --seq 2048 --target 480 --dur 00:45:00 --telemetry s3://redwood-bench/tmp
```
Priya: add `--hwmon-interval 1s --collect-dmesg --clock-sample 5s` and a short preheat baseline run (5m idle load).
Samir: if reproduced, next step is kernel bisect. prepare a narrow range: the affinity commit, the powercap driver, and the thermal driver tweak.
Jessie: also request partner to switch fan curve to 'aggressive' and re-run to see perf/W improvement. need delta numbers before any external-facing marketplace claim.
Alex M: partner replied: "we'll push fan-curve update tonight and re-run with powercap off. attaching BMC logs in morning." cc @Priya
bench-bot: telemetry upload available: s3://redwood-bench/partner/2026-03-20/run458/ (logs + hwmon + traces)
Alex M: reproduced locally. saw same P99 jump and `thermal_throttle` at gpu temp 73-75C. attaching local dmesg snippet.
Samir: that's consistent. schedule bisect job and lets include debug clocks kernel build. bench-bot can queue bisect.
bench-bot: bisect job submitted: id=bisect-82 node=local-4xA100 est=5h range=commit:abc123..def456
Jessie: I'll draft a private eng-to-eng note for the partner summarizing repro steps, the suggested fan curve + powercap defaults, and the short heatmap template (perf/W vs clock-bin).
Priya: product/marketplace, hold off on publishing any throughput-per-watt claims for that SKU until we verify stability across partner racks.
Alex M: agree. quick follow-ups: 1) partner to confirm fan curve patch applied 2) partner to run baseline + 45m sweep and upload telemetry 3) we'll run bisect and share minimal repro.
Samir: if bisect points to our sched change, we may recommend reverting that part for that OEM hardware and instead apply IRQ affinity fallback at deploy.
Jessie: meeting? if bisect narrows to a patch set, propose a 30-min eng-to-eng call this week to walk partner through repro and mitigation.
Alex M: leaving notes here after bisect completes. will update thread with job result and a short summary.
Priya: thanks all :thumbsup:
